summary: Full E2E test of the new 12-agent Campaign Engine + Traction Labs Intelligence brain. Backend pytest test_campaign_engine.py: 9/9 PASS in 5m55s — Intelligence industries/summary/list/delete work (hvac pre-seeded from prior WON campaign); POST /api/campaigns/build returns immediately with build_status='building'/progress='reality', background job populates reality → creative → conversion in Mongo; polling GET /api/campaigns/{id} eventually returns build_status='ready' with all three layers matching the documented schema (customer_reality/pain_hierarchy/belief_ladder/battlefield in reality; attention_plan + exactly 3 creative_concepts with all required keys; offer/funnel/trust_plan/testing_and_optimization/learning_tags in conversion, funnel has cold/interested/warm/ready + landing_page + retargeting + email_sequence + sms_sequence); POST /result status=won returned {status:'ok', learnings_recorded:>0} feeding the brain; refine conversion cascade=false re-ran only conversion (reality + creative unchanged); DELETE /api/campaigns/{id} works and GET returns 404 after. Regression: ran the existing test_batch_spy + test_creatives + test_ad_intel suites — 17/17 PASS, confirming the intelligence-block injection into /api/ads/create, /api/ads/analyze-competitor and /api/ads/batch-spy did NOT break them. Frontend (Playwright, real preview URL): sidebar nav-dash-intelligence renders /dashboard/intelligence page with 2 industry chips (All industries + hvac) and all 6 intel-group-* cards populated with entries and '×N' weight labels; opening TEST_E2E_HVAC → tab-engine reveals data-testid campaign-engine with ce-goal / ce-notes / ce-build; existing WON campaign chip selected renders ce-progress with reality/creative/conversion sections, all 3 ce-concept-0..2 with ce-copy-ad-0..2 and ce-copy-prompt-0..2 buttons, ce-refine-btn-reality/creative/conversion, and the refine panel with ce-refine-input-reality + ce-cascade-reality (checked=True by default) + ce-refine-run-reality. Mark Won button (ce-mark-won) correctly appears only for non-won campaigns.

ui_bugs.issue: Copy Ad Copy / Copy Higgsfield Prompt call navigator.clipboard.writeText() without a try/catch. In environments where the browser blocks clipboard writes (headless test contexts, iframes without allow=clipboard-write, insecure contexts, some Safari cases), this throws an uncaught NotAllowedError instead of showing the intended 'Copied' toast fallback. Repro: click ce-copy-ad-0 in headless Chromium → 'Uncaught runtime errors: Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied.'

React hydration warning: <button data-testid='ce-refine-btn-reality'> is nested inside the section header <button> (invalid HTML, buttons cannot be descendants of buttons). Same for ce-refine-btn-creative and ce-refine-btn-conversion. Works today, but React warns and could break in future versions. Fix: turn the outer header into a <div role='button' tabIndex={0}> or move the Refine button out of the header click-target and stop event propagation.

action_items: Wrap the two Copy buttons in CampaignEngine.jsx in try/catch around navigator.clipboard.writeText and fall back to a textarea + document.execCommand or just show an error toast — matches the BatchSpy copy handler pattern.

Fix the nested <button> hydration warning in the reality/creative/conversion Section header (CampaignEngine.jsx ~line 233): change the outer clickable header to a div (or stop click propagation on the inner Refine button).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1386 lines — split into routers (campaigns, intelligence, ads, clients, auth) to stay maintainable.

campaign_engine.py: all three run_* functions rely on the model returning strict JSON matching a large schema. There is no schema validation on the returned dict before persisting, so a malformed layer would still be stored. Consider pydantic-validating each layer's shape (or at least assert required top-level keys) before writing to Mongo — a partial write today silently degrades the UI.

_run_campaign_background swallows partial progress on failure: if Creative fails after Reality succeeded, build_status becomes 'failed' but Reality is still in the doc — the UI could offer a 'resume from creative' button; today the user must rebuild from scratch.

intelligence_service.record_learning uses a case-insensitive key but no length/dedup on value — a very slightly reworded hook creates a second entry with weight=3 instead of incrementing. Consider fuzzy-matching (or stemming) before upsert to make the brain actually converge.
CampaignEngine.jsx is ~500+ lines and multi-responsibility (list + view + refine + copy + progress + polling). Extracting CampaignList / CampaignView / RefinePanel would help testability.
Polling uses a 4.5s setInterval but does not stop when the tab becomes hidden — burns quota if the user leaves the tab open on a failed campaign.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all data-testids and flows verified; 2 non-blocking client-side issues noted)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created 2 campaigns against TEST_E2E_HVAC (one full-build marked WON contributing learnings, one stub deleted immediately). The WON one is left in Mongo — intentional, since it further seeds the hvac intelligence brain and mirrors the manual seed already present. TestIntelligence.test_list_and_delete deletes 1 hvac intel entry as part of the delete assertion — hvac still has plenty of remaining entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Campaign Engine full pipeline validated end-to-end (build + polling + refine cascade=false + mark-won → brain). Skipped: refine layer='reality' cascade=true and refine layer='creative' cascade=true — each would add ~3 min and ~2 min respectively of Claude time; the code path is symmetric with the cascade=false test we did run and with the mark-won test that consumed a fully-built campaign. If those variants are ever needed, the pattern is: POST /api/campaigns/{id}/refine with cascade=true → poll build_status until 'ready' → assert previous layer(s) unchanged. Higgsfield 'Generate image' inside creative concepts is expected to fail (out of credits) — that is orthogonal to Campaign Engine.
rca of the issue: N/A for backend (all pass). Frontend copy-button clipboard error RCA: in headless/insecure contexts navigator.clipboard is either undefined or refuses writes; CampaignEngine.jsx assumes it always succeeds and does not catch the promise rejection. The React nested-button warning is HTML spec violation (interactive-in-interactive) — Radix/shadcn tabs are fine, the problem is the app-authored section header <button> containing an inner Refine <button>.
